guide.overview: A single-target physical DPS Champion, Robin chains **[Afterimage]** attacks to ramp up his damage, while [Teen Titans] and [Bat Family] allies give him extra bonuses.

legacyPieces.name: Robin's Utility Belt
legacyPieces.reason: Increases Robin's Physical Penetration after he casts his Ultimate and increases his single-target damage. While [Afterimage] is active, his attacks have a chance to inflict [Silence].

legacyPieces.name: Gabriel Horn
legacyPieces.reason: Boosts crit-based damage and helps Robin keep his skills flowing, making it ideal for single-target bursts during [Afterimage].

legacyPieces.name: Not-So-Huge Hammer
legacyPieces.reason: Boosts Robin's overall combat performance, helping him enter [Afterimage] reliably and maintain steady single-target damage.

legacyPieces.name: Razor Rib Umbrella
legacyPieces.reason: Boosts Robin's overall stats and helps him stay effective in longer fights.
